sources.snippet: SmolVLA is a lightweight and efficient Vision-Language-Action model designed for low-cost robots, capable of training and inference on consumer-grade GPUs or even CPUs. Its core idea is to reuse the perception capabilities of a pretrained VLM but truncate its language decoding layers, using only mid-level features to condition a compact action generation head.
